Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent horse pawn sprite for the native RacingClub board game.
Input image 1 is ONLY the approved art-style reference; do not copy its UI. Create ONE refined chestnut horse miniature, full body, clean side profile facing RIGHT, gently cantering with two lifted legs. No rider. A simple forest-green saddlecloth, small warm ivory saddle edge and fine gold bridle. Dark flowing mane and tail. Attractive natural horse proportions, friendly expressive eye, rounded sculpted forms and soft hand-painted shading, sophisticated tactile board-game figurine matching the reference's honey wood and ivory equestrian storybook style. Clear unified silhouette, medium simple forms that remain legible when rendered only 50 pixels high; avoid tiny photographic detail. The four legs should be anatomically correct and visually separated. Horse fills 85–90 percent of a landscape 4:3 frame, entire ears, tail and hooves inside safe margins. Transparent background; no scene, no base, no ground, no cast shadow outside the horse, no circle, no text, no numerals, no extra characters. This is a polished functional game token, not a realistic cutout.

No floor, no scenery, no cast shadow outside object, no text, letters, numerals or words. Must remain recognizable at 60 pixels wide.
